# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. # Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

content.thinking:
The anthropic plumbing looks careful: `paramIndexOf` maps transcript messages to param messages (merged tool-result user messages), the history breakpoint lands on the prefix's last message's param, only when the request extends beyond the prefix. And the merged tool-result param note — the breakpoint applies to the param containing S0's last message... if S0's last message merged with the INSTRUCTION into one user param? Consecutive tool results merge; the instruction is a USER message following possibly an assistant/toolresult — can a toolResult + user merge into one param? `_convertMessageAt` merges consecutive tool RESULTS. A user text message starts a new param. So the instruction never merges into the prefix param. Good.

Budget of 4: system + tools + history-prefix + last-user (instruction) = 4 — at the limit. If Anthropic errors on >4... that's the documented design (ticket: "на пределе").

OK — I'm fairly confident in my own findings now. Let me check the legs one more time; if still running, I'll observe handover-engine (95%→compacted) to see where it is.

# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (3) hand_over_ladder.dart — nudge on tool-call reply (exactly one, same prefix), length→2x retry, exhausted ladder appends NOTHING; check no silent swallowing and no accidental fallback to judge/digest/classic. (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

Verified candidate findings with exact file:line evidence; empty list if clean.

data.task:
# Target
Snapshot/tag/host layer of PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): NEW lib/src/compaction/record_tag.dart, lib/src/compaction/request_snapshot.dart, lib/src/compaction/compaction_mode.dart, lib/src/compaction/hand_over_trigger.dart; modified lib/src/agent/agent.dart, agent_loop.dart, agent_loop_message_cap.dart, lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart (big diff incl. rework commit b0e5fd6d1a), lib/src/compaction/token_estimation.dart, tuning.dart, host_wiring.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, agent_cli_compaction.dart, agent_cli_run.dart, cli_help.dart, flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, agent_service_compaction.dart, agent_service_events.dart, agent_service_sessions.dart.

# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

(4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. data.task:
# Target
Snapshot/tag/host layer of PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): NEW lib/src/compaction/record_tag.dart, lib/src/compaction/request_snapshot.dart, lib/src/compaction/compaction_mode.dart, lib/src/compaction/hand_over_trigger.dart; modified lib/src/agent/agent.dart, agent_loop.dart, agent_loop_message_cap.dart, lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart (big diff incl. rework commit b0e5fd6d1a), lib/src/compaction/token_estimation.dart, tuning.dart, host_wiring.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, agent_cli_compaction.dart, agent_cli_run.dart, cli_help.dart, flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, agent_service_compaction.dart, agent_service_events.dart, agent_service_sessions.dart.

# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

# Acceptance
Verified candidate findings with exact file:line evidence; empty list if clean.

content.thinking:
The handover-engine leg completed with two findings:

1. **BLOCKING** — heading regex divergence: gate accepts `##Open User Requests` (`\s*`), belt requires `\s+` → gate passes but belt is blinded → laundering class. This matches my own digest observation (#7) — the leg verified it as a security-relevant BLOCKING. Let me verify the exact claim: hand_over.dart:292 `_userIntentHeading` with `\s*`; summary_sanitizer.dart:208-211 `\s+`. And the flow: verifyOpenUserRequests passes (heading true per gate regex) → sanitizeSummary's belt early-returns → ungraded. Wait — order of operations in `_handOverTransfer`: `sanitizeSummary(...)` runs FIRST, THEN `verifyOpenUserRequests(transfer, openAsks)`. The sanitization happens on the raw text; if the text has `##Open User Requests`, the belt early-returns (no belt) — then the verify heading check (tolerant regex) passes → persisted with an UNGRADED section. The claim holds mechanically. Severity: is it BLOCKING? The laundering requires the MODEL to write the no-space variant — either by chance or stered by injected content. The whole point of D2/#81 is that the gate makes laundering impossible; a one-char variant defeats the belt. The verbatim check still guarantees the mechanical asks are present (that part isn't bypassed), but the belt's ephemeral-claim/tool-quote grading is bypassed for that section. It's a real security-gate bypass — I'd accept 🚨 BLOCKING (security on a touched path). Let me verify the two regexes and the early return.

2. **IMPORTANT** — one-sided normalization in the verbatim check (zero-width chars / leading m-tags on the mechanical side) → permanent fail-closed stall. This overlaps my finding #4 (same root, mine was about stripRecordTags; theirs adds the zero-width angle and "no fallback → permanent stall"). I'll merge them into ONE finding (mine anchored at engine_hand_over.dart:163; theirs at hand_over.dart:323). I'll keep one thread — the richer claim (theirs) with my anchor or theirs. Their anchor hand_over.dart:323 is inside `verifyOpenUserRequests` — a diff line ✓. Mine at engine_hand_over.dart:163. I'll merge into one IMPORTANT thread anchored at hand_over.dart:323 mentioning both normalization directions and the fail-forever consequence.

Let me verify the BLOCKING claim's regexes now.

data.task:
# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (3) hand_over_ladder.dart — nudge on tool-call reply (exactly one, same prefix), length→2x retry, exhausted ladder appends NOTHING; check no silent swallowing and no accidental fallback to judge/digest/classic. (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

Verified candidate findings with exact file:line evidence; empty list if clean.

# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. # Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (3) hand_over_ladder.dart — nudge on tool-call reply (exactly one, same prefix), length→2x retry, exhausted ladder appends NOTHING; check no silent swallowing and no accidental fallback to judge/digest/classic. (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

Verified candidate findings with exact file:line evidence; empty list if clean.

data.task:
# Target
Snapshot/tag/host layer of PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): NEW lib/src/compaction/record_tag.dart, lib/src/compaction/request_snapshot.dart, lib/src/compaction/compaction_mode.dart, lib/src/compaction/hand_over_trigger.dart; modified lib/src/agent/agent.dart, agent_loop.dart, agent_loop_message_cap.dart, lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart (big diff incl. rework commit b0e5fd6d1a), lib/src/compaction/token_estimation.dart, tuning.dart, host_wiring.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, agent_cli_compaction.dart, agent_cli_run.dart, cli_help.dart, flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, agent_service_compaction.dart, agent_service_events.dart, agent_service_sessions.dart.

# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

data.name: handover-engine
data.task:
# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (3) hand_over_ladder.dart — nudge on tool-call reply (exactly one, same prefix), length→2x retry, exhausted ladder appends NOTHING; check no silent swallowing and no accidental fallback to judge/digest/classic. (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

Verified candidate findings with exact file:line evidence; empty list if clean.

# Target
Snapshot/tag/host layer of PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): NEW lib/src/compaction/record_tag.dart, lib/src/compaction/request_snapshot.dart, lib/src/compaction/compaction_mode.dart, lib/src/compaction/hand_over_trigger.dart; modified lib/src/agent/agent.dart, agent_loop.dart, agent_loop_message_cap.dart, lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart (big diff incl. rework commit b0e5fd6d1a), lib/src/compaction/token_estimation.dart, tuning.dart, host_wiring.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, agent_cli_compaction.dart, agent_cli_run.dart, cli_help.dart, flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, agent_service_compaction.dart, agent_service_events.dart, agent_service_sessions.dart.

# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

data.task:
# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (3) hand_over_ladder.dart — nudge on tool-call reply (exactly one, same prefix), length→2x retry, exhausted ladder appends NOTHING; check no silent swallowing and no accidental fallback to judge/digest/classic. (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

(2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

data.task:
# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (3) hand_over_ladder.dart — nudge on tool-call reply (exactly one, same prefix), length→2x retry, exhausted ladder appends NOTHING; check no silent swallowing and no accidental fallback to judge/digest/classic. (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). # Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (3) hand_over_ladder.dart — nudge on tool-call reply (exactly one, same prefix), length→2x retry, exhausted ladder appends NOTHING; check no silent swallowing and no accidental fallback to judge/digest/classic. (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

General comment it is; census counts it important), ⚠️ I3 asks normalization stall, ⚠️ I4 persist-gate untested hostile text, ⚠️ I5 host wiring untested (E21/gate).

# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (3) hand_over_ladder.dart — nudge on tool-call reply (exactly one, same prefix), length→2x retry, exhausted ladder appends NOTHING; check no silent swallowing and no accidental fallback to judge/digest/classic. (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

arguments.content:
🚨 **BLOCKING: `##Open User Requests` (no space) passes the mandatory-section gate but blinds the provenance belt — laundering path reopens**

The gate and the belt it exists to arm use **divergent heading regexes**:

- gate (`lib/src/compaction/structured/hand_over.dart:291-293`): `^(?:#{1,6}\s*)?(?:open user requests\b|open asks\b\s*:)` — `\s*`, **zero** whitespace accepted;
- belt (`lib/src/compaction/summary_sanitizer.dart:208-211`): `^(?:#{1,6}\s+)?…` — `\s+`, **one-or-more** required, with an early return when no heading matches (`:276`: `if (!_userIntentHeading.hasMatch(text)) return text;`).

Order of operations in `_handOverTransfer` (`lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart:160-170`): `sanitizeSummary` runs **first**, then `verifyOpenUserRequests`. A reply that writes the heading as `##Open User Requests` or `#open asks:` (no space — trivially steerable by payload-injected tool text, the PR's own threat model input 1/3) therefore:

1. gets **no belt grading** — machine-origin synthetic asks and unevidenced tool quotes inside the section ride into the durable `compact_checkpoint` unstripped, unmarked — the exact laundering class gh-2103 and ticket D2/#81 close ("belt не работает без заголовка", N1);
2. still **passes** `verifyOpenUserRequests` (heading `true`, asks verbatim) — so the run persists and reports success.

The gate's own doc says the opposite contract: "without it the sanitizer belt cannot run, so the run FAILS" (`hand_over.dart:299-302`). Fix: share one heading pattern (gate adopts `\s+`, or both reuse a single exported regex), and add the `##Open…` variant as a payload fixture (ticket UT-12/IT-09 list).

arguments.content:
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: `CompactingGate.run` joins a second caller unregistered — the joined body escapes the D9 queue**

`CompactingGate.run` (`lib/src/compaction/hand_over_trigger.dart:153-165`) joins a caller while a run is in flight by awaiting the active completer and then executing `body()` **without re-registering it** (`:156-157`). During that joined body `isCompacting` is `false` and `wait()` (`:170-176`) returns immediately.

Concrete interleaving on both hosts: run A settles → post-run compaction #1 holds the gate; a run that does not pass `_beginUserPrompt` (a reaction/scheduled/background-job run) settles while #1 is still in flight → `_afterRun`'s `gate.run` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_run.dart:367`) joins → body #2 executes unregistered after #1 completes; a user prompt arriving during body #2 now skips the queue (`agent_service.dart:2021` checks `isCompacting`; `_beginUserPrompt`'s `gate.wait()`, `agent_cli_run.dart:138`, returns immediately) and its pre-flight measures/compacts while #2's appends and `_refreshState` are mid-flight — the exact double-`_refreshState`/lost-persist hazard D9/AC12 (E33, IT-19) introduces the gate to prevent. `wait()`'s while-loop only re-checks registered runs, so it cannot catch this either.

Fix: in the join branch, register the joined body as the active compaction (set `_active` before `body()`, complete in `finally`), so `isCompacting`/`wait()` see it; a unit test with two overlapping `run` calls + a concurrent `wait()` would pin it (none exists today).

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the verbatim-asks check normalizes one side only — a session whose asks carry wire-tag/zero-width text can never fold (permanent fail-closed loop)**

`verifyOpenUserRequests` (`lib/src/compaction/structured/hand_over.dart:314-328`) compares the **normalized** reply against the **raw** mechanical block:

- reply side: `sanitizeSummary(stripRecordTags(stripThinkBlocks(raw)), …)` (`engine_hand_over.dart:163`) — `stripRecordTags` drops a leading `m<digits> ` from **every** line (`record_tag.dart:63-65`) and the belt may append ` [from toolResult]` annotations;
- mechanical side: `userRequestCandidateLines` output — raw record text, only `\s+`-flattened at `hand_over.dart:323`; U+200B/U+200C/U+200D/U+2060 are not `\s` and survive there.

So a user turn that starts with `m<digits> ` (quoting an alias) or contains a zero-width char (pasted text) can **never** be contained in the normalized transfer → the run fails (E36) and nothing is appended. With no fallback (AC4 by design), every subsequent post-run soft trigger re-runs the 2–3 round-trip hand-over and fails again: a **permanent compaction stall** for that session, loud but unfixable without editing history. A sanitizer `[from toolResult]` mark inside an echoed ask breaks verbatim the same way (ticket AC6 wants asks verbatim; `protectedLines` covers only pinned lines).

Fix: normalize both sides identically — run the mechanical ask lines through the same zero-width/tag stripping before the containment check (and/or pass the ask lines as `protectedLines` so the belt keeps them byte-stable).

arguments.content:
💡 **SUGGESTION: the new `[expand …]` branch of `isCompactionMarkerText` is end-anchored only — ordinary content ending in a quoted pointer flips real boundaries**

`_expandPointerPattern = RegExp(r'\[expand \d+(?:-\d+)?\]\s*$')` (`lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart:164`, consumed at `:177-181`) classifies **any** message text that merely *ends* with a bracketed `[expand N]`/`[expand N-M]` as a compaction marker. The legacy branch is start-anchored (`^\[\d+…:(hidden|ckpt)·`, `:155`) and essentially never occurs naturally; the new form does — this repo's own docs and skill texts quote `[expand 3-140]` routinely, and a tool result whose last line is such a quote now matches.

Three boundary detectors key off the predicate, where the false positive has real cost:

- `isPinRenumberingBoundary` (`lib/src/skills/operative_pins.dart:396-412`): after a false boundary the pinned-operative carrier block is **suppressed** for the rest of the window — a "pinned verbatim" directive silently stops rendering although the skill body is not in context;
- `_nearestCutBoundary` (`lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart:702`): pairing diagnostics mislabeled "context marker";
- the image registry's citation-trust boundary (issue #195 F2).

The ticket's D12/security blessing covers **forged** markers in tool text as safe degradation — not this accidental-match class on genuine content. Suggest anchoring to the engine-rendered whole-line form: optional `m<N> ` tag, then at most a ≤6-word bracket-free label, then the pointer at end-of-text — coincidental quotes then resolve like the old start-anchored form.

💡 **SUGGESTION: the classic parity suite strips `m<N> ` before shape checks — a classic-engine tag leak would ship green (E37/AC15 unasserted)**

`contentSignatures` (`test/cli/agent_cli_resume_parity_test.dart:175-180`) strips `^(user|assistant|tool):m\d+ ` before the `user:old`-style shape comparisons, and the suite pins `compactionEngine.classic` (`:116`, `:138`) — but **no assertion anywhere checks that classic wires carry no tags** (E37: "classic: тегов и merged нет"). The raw `signatures` compare host-vs-host only, so if `recordTagsEnabled` ever leaked onto classic requests both sides would carry the same tags and every test stays green while the promised byte-identity (AC15/REG-08/REG-09: classic golden, one-invalidation engine switch, windowed cases) breaks.

One assertion pins the contract: in a classic-pinned run, capture a request context and expect `leadingRecordTag` on no message text (the helper already exists in `record_tag.dart`). Same test can cover the structured↔classic switch invalidation (REG-08/09) at the store level.

# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The merged hand-over core (parser, dispose buckets, no-fallback ladder, marker forms, session-record backward compat) is solid and well-tested, but two blocking defects and one contract gap must be fixed first: the request snapshot (S0) is never invalidated on session switch / rewind / `/handoff` / partial appends, so the merged call can run over the *wrong session's* transcript; and a heading-variant (`##Open User Requests`, no space) passes the mandatory-section gate while blinding the provenance belt, reopening the gh-2103 laundering path.

**Key Issues** (2 🚨 · 5 ⚠️ · 6 💡 · 4 🪶):
- 🚨 Stale S0 across projection-replacing host transitions → merged hand-over over the wrong context / compaction outage loop (`session_commands.dart:985`, thread 1).
- 🚨 Gate/belt heading regex divergence (`\s*` vs `\s+`) → ungraded user-intent section persisted (`hand_over.dart:292`, thread 2).
- ⚠️ `CompactingGate.run` joins bodies unregistered → D9 queue bypassed (`hand_over_trigger.dart:157`); ⚠️ verbatim-asks normalization is one-sided → permanent fail-closed fold stall (`hand_over.dart:323`); ⚠️ AC19/D1 gap: the judge ladder is kept (PR self-declares; ticket D1 says judge removed and hide-only mode abolished — needs an explicit owner call or the follow-up card); ⚠️ merged persist-site laundering gate has no hostile-text test; ⚠️ host D9/E21 wiring (gate seam, success-only S0 invalidation) untested.
- 🪶 digest: `legacy_session_resume_test.dart:350` duplicate assertion · `prompts/compaction/hand_over.md:3` unquoted YAML `#` truncates the generated doc · `engine_hand_over.dart:275` `judgeCalls` reused for hand-over call count · `record_tag.dart:187` a genuine record opening with `m<N> ` is treated as already tagged (alias confusion).

**Next Steps**:
1. Invalidate/key S0 on session load-switch, rewind, `/handoff`, and any run that appended (drop the `reportedPass` condition) + host-level lifecycle test.
2. Share one user-intent heading regex between gate and belt + add the `##Open…` payload fixture.
3. Register joined gate bodies; normalize both sides of the verbatim-asks check.
4. Owner decision on AC19 (judge removal) — land it here or split a dedicated card.
5. Add the hostile-transfer and host-wiring tests; then the 💡 threads (marker end-anchor, parity tag-strip, Copilot header, IT-10/IT-17 tails).

(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.

# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). # Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.

data.task:
# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (3) hand_over_ladder.dart — nudge on tool-call reply (exactly one, same prefix), length→2x retry, exhausted ladder appends NOTHING; check no silent swallowing and no accidental fallback to judge/digest/classic. (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

data.name: snapshot-tags-hosts
data.task:
# Target
Snapshot/tag/host layer of PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): NEW lib/src/compaction/record_tag.dart, lib/src/compaction/request_snapshot.dart, lib/src/compaction/compaction_mode.dart, lib/src/compaction/hand_over_trigger.dart; modified lib/src/agent/agent.dart, agent_loop.dart, agent_loop_message_cap.dart, lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart (big diff incl. rework commit b0e5fd6d1a), lib/src/compaction/token_estimation.dart, tuning.dart, host_wiring.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, agent_cli_compaction.dart, agent_cli_run.dart, cli_help.dart, flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, agent_service_compaction.dart, agent_service_events.dart, agent_service_sessions.dart.

# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

Verified candidate findings with exact file:line evidence; empty list if clean.

(6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (3) hand_over_ladder.dart — nudge on tool-call reply (exactly one, same prefix), length→2x retry, exhausted ladder appends NOTHING; check no silent swallowing and no accidental fallback to judge/digest/classic. (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

Verified candidate findings with exact file:line evidence; empty list if clean.

# Target
Snapshot/tag/host layer of PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): NEW lib/src/compaction/record_tag.dart, lib/src/compaction/request_snapshot.dart, lib/src/compaction/compaction_mode.dart, lib/src/compaction/hand_over_trigger.dart; modified lib/src/agent/agent.dart, agent_loop.dart, agent_loop_message_cap.dart, lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart (big diff incl. rework commit b0e5fd6d1a), lib/src/compaction/token_estimation.dart, tuning.dart, host_wiring.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, agent_cli_compaction.dart, agent_cli_run.dart, cli_help.dart, flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, agent_service_compaction.dart, agent_service_events.dart, agent_service_sessions.dart.

# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

Snapshot/tag/host layer of PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): NEW lib/src/compaction/record_tag.dart, lib/src/compaction/request_snapshot.dart, lib/src/compaction/compaction_mode.dart, lib/src/compaction/hand_over_trigger.dart; modified lib/src/agent/agent.dart, agent_loop.dart, agent_loop_message_cap.dart, lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart (big diff incl. rework commit b0e5fd6d1a), lib/src/compaction/token_estimation.dart, tuning.dart, host_wiring.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, agent_cli_compaction.dart, agent_cli_run.dart, cli_help.dart, flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, agent_service_compaction.dart, agent_service_events.dart, agent_service_sessions.dart.

# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? data.task:
# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (3) hand_over_ladder.dart — nudge on tool-call reply (exactly one, same prefix), length→2x retry, exhausted ladder appends NOTHING; check no silent swallowing and no accidental fallback to judge/digest/classic. (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

# Acceptance
Verified candidate findings with exact file:line evidence; empty list if clean.

(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.

# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (3) hand_over_ladder.dart — nudge on tool-call reply (exactly one, same prefix), length→2x retry, exhausted ladder appends NOTHING; check no silent swallowing and no accidental fallback to judge/digest/classic. (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

Snapshot/tag/host layer of PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): NEW lib/src/compaction/record_tag.dart, lib/src/compaction/request_snapshot.dart, lib/src/compaction/compaction_mode.dart, lib/src/compaction/hand_over_trigger.dart; modified lib/src/agent/agent.dart, agent_loop.dart, agent_loop_message_cap.dart, lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart (big diff incl. rework commit b0e5fd6d1a), lib/src/compaction/token_estimation.dart, tuning.dart, host_wiring.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, agent_cli_compaction.dart, agent_cli_run.dart, cli_help.dart, flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, agent_service_compaction.dart, agent_service_events.dart, agent_service_sessions.dart.

# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.
