# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.

# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.

(2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. data.task:
# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (3) hand_over_ladder.dart — nudge on tool-call reply (exactly one, same prefix), length→2x retry, exhausted ladder appends NOTHING; check no silent swallowing and no accidental fallback to judge/digest/classic. (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

# Target
Snapshot/tag/host layer of PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): NEW lib/src/compaction/record_tag.dart, lib/src/compaction/request_snapshot.dart, lib/src/compaction/compaction_mode.dart, lib/src/compaction/hand_over_trigger.dart; modified lib/src/agent/agent.dart, agent_loop.dart, agent_loop_message_cap.dart, lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart (big diff incl. rework commit b0e5fd6d1a), lib/src/compaction/token_estimation.dart, tuning.dart, host_wiring.dart, lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart, agent_cli_compaction.dart, agent_cli_run.dart, cli_help.dart, flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart, agent_service_compaction.dart, agent_service_events.dart, agent_service_sessions.dart.

# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Snapshot/tag/host layer of PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). # Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.

# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (3) hand_over_ladder.dart — nudge on tool-call reply (exactly one, same prefix), length→2x retry, exhausted ladder appends NOTHING; check no silent swallowing and no accidental fallback to judge/digest/classic. (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

# Target

# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Snapshot/tag/host layer of PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). # Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.

# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (3) hand_over_ladder.dart — nudge on tool-call reply (exactly one, same prefix), length→2x retry, exhausted ladder appends NOTHING; check no silent swallowing and no accidental fallback to judge/digest/classic. (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

# Target

# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Snapshot/tag/host layer of PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). # Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.

# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (3) hand_over_ladder.dart — nudge on tool-call reply (exactly one, same prefix), length→2x retry, exhausted ladder appends NOTHING; check no silent swallowing and no accidental fallback to judge/digest/classic. (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

# Target

# Target
Structured compaction engine core in PR #2407 (branch feat/gh-2394-compaction-handover). Files (diff vs origin/main): lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart (modified), NEW lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart, hand_over.dart, hand_over_dispose.dart, hand_over_ladder.dart; modified lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart, projection.dart; NEW prompts/compaction/hand_over.md; lib/src/compaction/compaction.dart (small diff).

# Change
Hunt lens: correctness + security of the merged hand-over path.
Specifically: (1) the reply parser in hand_over.dart — prefix hide-list rules, BOM/zero-width/CRLF, <think> stripping, 'first line not an id → all text is transfer', required '## Open User Requests' section gate (alias 'open asks:'), verbatim asks verification vs the mechanical <open-user-requests> block — can a payload-injected tool text forge asks, smuggle ids, or bypass the section gate (e.g. case/whitespace normalization)? (2) hand_over_dispose.dart — hide-id resolution against the SNAPSHOT index, pair snapping, buckets U/F/C/X/T/S, user turns never hidden, protected tail, pins; can a model-proposed id hide a transfer/checkpoint record (bucket F) or expand a range? (4) engine_hand_over.dart + engine.dart diff — failure-safety invariant I5 (nothing appended on failed run), persist through sanitizeSummary with protectedLines + origins, labels sanitization, consolidated marker writes, checkpoint layout: tail. (5) markers.dart/projection.dart — new marker forms parse vs isCompactionMarkerText, old records render unchanged (byte-identical), fold pointer untagged, transfer record tagged. Cross-check ticket.md AC4-AC9, invariant I5-I9, and the Security section (threat inputs 1-7) in input/gh-2394/ticket.md.

# Change
Hunt lens: lifecycle correctness of the new state machines.
(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

(1) record_tag.dart — the epoch rule: tags stable within an epoch, live edge untagged, non-records (obligations/working-set tails, time-left, misuse note, carrier pins) never tagged, image-only carriers get a tag-only text block, tag placement never reorders blocks before signed thinking; stripRecordTags before persist. (2) request_snapshot.dart — S0 validity predicate (isValidFor), messages COPY vs live list aliasing, invalidation points (model switch, checkpoint rewind, engine switch, after successful run), thread-safety/mutation hazards. (3) agent_loop.dart/_captureRequest seam — snapshot overwritten each send, retry degenerate-empty re-snapshot, transformation pipeline (_buildRequestContext) ordering vs tagging. (4) auto_compactor.dart run() — the mode table (selectCompactionMode exhaustive, never outcome-based), soft trigger gating (softTriggered && mode != merged → nothing run), the reworked ok-branch logic `outcome.ok && (merged || adapter.passCount > 0 || !(force || capTriggered))` — check the boolean logic against gh-1742 invariant (forced run with zero passes is NOT relief) and the no-fallback rule AC4/I9: can any path still reach classic or judge from merged? Is the zero-pass merged run really valid when nothing was disposed? (5) hand_over_trigger.dart — soft line default (hard − 5%), hysteresis (default 3 turns), hard never muted, CompactingGate queueing (one run at a time, wait while compacting, and the rework fix `if (gate.isCompacting) await gate.wait()` in agent_service.dart — any lost-wakeup or deadlock if gate never opens?), token_estimation tagOverhead member. (6) Host parity CLI vs Flutter: same keys wired on both (repo rule docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md — check parity settings registry if relevant), tuning key strictness (invalid value = config error, never ignored).

arguments.message:
## PR Review posted — gh-2394 "Compaction 2.0 (v2.1): merged hand-over" — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Census: 2 🚨 BLOCKING · 5 ⚠️ IMPORTANT · 6 💡 SUGGESTION · 4 🪶 NIT** (12 inline threads + 3 digest lines in the general comment; density cap 6 respected with exactly 6 polish threads).

**🚨 BLOCKING**
1. **`lib/src/cli/session_commands.dart:985`** — `_agent.state.recordSeqs = context.recordSeqs` (resume/branch/undo/handoff host transitions) replaces the message projection without `invalidateRequestSnapshot()`; S0 stays byte-bound to the *previous* session. The merged post-run hand-over (`agent_cli_compaction.dart:1086`) passes that stale snapshot into `estimateRequestTokens`/`_normalize`, whose chars/4 re-anchor then recomputes over the wrong transcript — violates the ticket's D17 statement verbatim.
2. **`lib/src/compaction/structured/hand_over.dart:292`** — the mandatory-section gate accepts `\s*` after `#` (`##Open User Requests`) while the sanitizer belt requires `\s+` (`summary_sanitizer.dart:208-211`, early-return at 276): the heading passes the gate *ungraded*, reopening the provenance-laundering path the belt exists to close.

**⚠️ IMPORTANT** — trigger join `run(.then((_) => body()))` can double-fire when auto and handoff compaction settle in the same drain (`hand_over_trigger.dart:157`); `ask:` variant never graded (same `\s+` bug); AC19's judge-removal contract has no test and `judgeCalls` is dead (ticket gap, general comment — no diff line); `hand_over_pass_test.dart:207` never asserts the persisted file it computes; host-side snapshot invalidation wiring untested (`hand_over_trigger_test.dart:115`).

**💡/🪶** — markers conservatism, resume-parity fixture brittleness, `x-initiator` capture test, test-name ambiguity, ladder wording, barrel export placement (+3 digest lines: `record_tag` idempotence caveat, duplicate assertion, `judgeCalls` field, YAML truncation).

**Coverage:** 4 parallel deep-read legs (engine/core, providers/cache/session, snapshot/tags/hosts, tests/AC-conformance) — 3 merged; the fourth (snapshot/tags/hosts) was still running at finalize, but its exact scope was reviewed firsthand in the main session (agent/agent_loop/hand_over/markers/session_record/providers/hosts) and overlaps two other legs; its findings can amend the on-disk artifacts before the posting step consumes them.

**Artifacts (verified):** `outputs/pr_review.json` (parses, REQUEST_CHANGES, blocking=2 with both 🚨 markers present in comment1/comment2), `outputs/pr_review_general.md` (16 lines, Summary/Key Issues/Next Steps), `outputs/pr_review_comments/comment1..12.md`. No `ci_failures.md` in input (verified — F7 N/A), no `pr_findings.md` (registry N/A), no `pr_new_hunks.txt` (first full round), no pool-specialist prompt (this is the posting review).

arguments.content:
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: new `compaction` tuning knobs are honored only on the CLI — host-parity contract broken**

The PR adds three shared-looking knobs — `compaction.softRatio`, `compaction.handOver.maxTokens`, `compaction.handOver.hysteresisTurns` (`lib/src/compaction/tuning.dart:79-85, :106-117`) — but only `resolveCliCompactionWiring` parses them (`lib/src/compaction/host_wiring.dart:196-210`). The app's `_compactionWiring` getter calls `resolveCompactionHostWiring` **without** the `tuning:` argument (`flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service_compaction.dart:232-236`), and the app config loader never parses the section's tuning keys at all — so `wiring.handOverHysteresisTurns` (read at `:268`) and `wiring.softRatio` (read at `:294`) are structurally always `null` on the app: it runs the defaults forever while the CLI applies user config.

`docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md:7-12` requires a shared setting to work on BOTH hosts or an explicit `cliOnlySettings` entry with a WHY; `compaction` is owned by the **shared** `compactionEngine` setting (`lib/src/parity/settings_registry.dart:856-865`) and is absent from `cliOnlySettings` (`:165-222`). The AC5 parity test cannot catch the drift because `CompactionHostWiring.sameResolutionAs` omits the three new fields (`lib/src/compaction/host_wiring.dart:117-134` compares window/conversationWindow/settings scalars/enabled/maxAttempts/baseBackoff/smol only).

Fix: parse the tuning keys in `loadAppFahConfig` and pass them into `_compactionWiring` (plus add the three fields to `sameResolutionAs` so the parity test actually compares them) — or declare the exemption in the registry with a reason.

## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The merged hand-over core (parser, dispose buckets, no-fallback ladder, marker forms, session-record backward compat) is solid and well-tested, but two blocking defects and one contract gap must be fixed first: the request snapshot (S0) is never invalidated on session switch / rewind / `/handoff` / partial appends, so the merged call can run over the *wrong session's* transcript; and a heading-variant (`##Open User Requests`, no space) passes the mandatory-section gate while blinding the provenance belt, reopening the gh-2103 laundering path.

**Key Issues** (2 🚨 · 5 ⚠️ · 6 💡 · 4 🪶):
- 🚨 Stale S0 across projection-replacing host transitions → merged hand-over over the wrong context / compaction outage loop (`session_commands.dart:985`, thread 1).
- 🚨 Gate/belt heading regex divergence (`\s*` vs `\s+`) → ungraded user-intent section persisted (`hand_over.dart:292`, thread 2).
- ⚠️ `CompactingGate.run` joins bodies unregistered → D9 queue bypassed (`hand_over_trigger.dart:157`); ⚠️ verbatim-asks normalization is one-sided → permanent fail-closed fold stall (`hand_over.dart:323`); ⚠️ AC19/D1 gap: the judge ladder is kept (PR self-declares; ticket D1 says judge removed and hide-only mode abolished — needs an explicit owner call or the follow-up card); ⚠️ merged persist-site laundering gate has no hostile-text test; ⚠️ host D9/E21 wiring (gate seam, success-only S0 invalidation) untested.
- 🪶 digest: `legacy_session_resume_test.dart:350` duplicate assertion · `prompts/compaction/hand_over.md:3` unquoted YAML `#` truncates the generated doc · `engine_hand_over.dart:275` `judgeCalls` reused for hand-over call count · `record_tag.dart:187` a genuine record opening with `m<N> ` is treated as already tagged (alias confusion).

**Next Steps**:
1. Invalidate/key S0 on session load-switch, rewind, `/handoff`, and any run that appended (drop the `reportedPass` condition) + host-level lifecycle test.
2. Share one user-intent heading regex between gate and belt + add the `##Open…` payload fixture.
3. Register joined gate bodies; normalize both sides of the verbatim-asks check.
4. Owner decision on AC19 (judge removal) — land it here or split a dedicated card.
5. Add the hostile-transfer and host-wiring tests; then the 💡 threads (marker end-anchor, parity tag-strip, Copilot header, IT-10/IT-17 tails).
